text:
Jess: quick follow-up from today's design review — the schema preview inspector feels cramped when function definitions get long. trying to capture fixes before next sprint :spiral_note_pad:
Samir: +1. noticed the clipboard icon gets pushed off-screen when there are >6 params. hard to copy param examples :clipboard:
Anya: idea: show a collapsed param-summary row with counts + a 'View full schema' inline modal. modal would have a11y focus trap and keyboard copy (cmd/c).
Kevin: a11y nits: modal needs role=dialog, aria-labelledby, and an aria-live region for copy success. also ensure high-contrast icons for the clipboard button.
Jess: run-history edge: when opening an old run that invoked tools, the schema preview is empty until you toggle the tool header. feels like hydration mismatch or lazy load bug. repro steps in a sec.
Samir: i can repro on prod preview. steps:
```
1. playground -> run history
2. open run with tool-calls
3. expand the tool panel
4. observe empty schema preview until toggle
```
Samir: attaching a short recording (posted to #eng-releases) — it's quick to see.
Anya: UX tradeoff question: keep inline modal or expand-to-side panel? inline modal is less layout-shift but hard to compare schema vs output. side panel is good for side-by-side but eats horizontal real estate.
Kevin: my vote for modal + 'detach' affordance (open as side panel). that covers both patterns and keeps default compact.
Jess: copy flow tweak: current tooltip says "Copied" but disappears too fast for screen reader users. change to persistent status in aria-live until next copy.
DesignBot: automated contrast check: clipboard icon (gray #9AA6B2) fails AA for 12px sizes — recommend #6B7280 or larger target.
Anya: microcopy: change "View schema" -> "View request schema (read-only)" to set expectation. also add small hint: "Use cmd/C to copy example payload."
Samir: dev note: there's a JSON pretty-print function in utils/schemaFormat we can reuse for modal rendering. will add pagination for huge schemas (>200 lines).
Kevin: keyboard flow: focus should land on first interactive element in modal (search), and Esc closes modal. tab order must include the copy button and close button.
Jess: follow-ups for next sprint:
- Samir: bugfix hydration + ensure schema renders on initial open (owner)
- Anya: prototype modal + detach affordance (owner)
- Kevin: a11y checklist + aria-live copy pattern (owner)
- Design: update microcopy and tooltip timing (owner: Jess)
Please add time estimates in the ticket and we can prioritize. :+1:
Anya: quick poll — prefer modal default or side-panel default? react with :one: for modal, :two: for side-panel.
Samir: :one:
Kevin: :one:
Jess: :one: (lean modal, detach when needed)
DesignBot: created ticket RD-UX-3147 with summary "Schema preview inspector — modal + detach, clipboard a11y fixes" and linked this thread.
